en.axtermConfig.cannotImport: Resolve the listed conflicts or invalid references, then choose the file again.
en.dataSync.gistRecoveryStepOpen: In GitHub, open the configured Gist and copy its HTTPS clone URL. Treat an unlisted Gist URL as sensitive.
en.dataSync.gistRecoveryStepClone: Use GitHub Desktop or another trusted Git client to clone it into a new private local directory. Do not push changes.
en.dataSync.gistRecoveryStepBackup: Find the configured sync file in the clone and copy it to a separate protected backup location.
en.dataSync.gistRecoveryStepVerify: Record the backup file size in bytes and its SHA-256. Keep the existing profile and remote Gist unchanged until you verify the backup and the new Axterm profile.
en.dataSync.gistCloneRequired: GitHub returned an incomplete Gist response. Clone the Gist with a Git client and back up the sync file before continuing. Axterm has not changed the remote Gist.
en.dataSync.giteeTruncated: Gitee returned incomplete Gist data. Axterm has not changed the remote file. Keep the old profile and remote file unchanged; obtain and verify a complete backup before migration.
